def: a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple)

occurrences.text: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
